pois.name: Grossmünster
pois.description: Romanesque twin-towered church overlooking the Limmat River, anchor of the Swiss Reformation with Karlsturm panoramic climbs.

pois.name: Fraumünster
pois.description: Former 9th-century abbey church celebrated for its slender copper spire and luminous stained-glass choir windows by Marc Chagall and Augusto Giacometti.

pois.name: St. Peter Church
pois.description: Zurich's oldest parish church, crowned by a medieval tower holding the largest clock face in Europe.

pois.name: Lindenhof
pois.description: Shaded linden-tree hilltop terrace on the site of a Roman fort offering sweeping views over Niederdorf roofs, the Limmat, and Grossmünster.

pois.name: Kunsthaus Zürich
pois.description: Switzerland's premier fine-arts museum spanning medieval altarpieces, Giacometti sculptures, Hodler paintings, and David Chipperfield's sunlit limestone extension.

pois.name: Landesmuseum Zürich
pois.description: Swiss National Museum housed in a fairy-tale historicist château beside Zürich HB, connected to Christ & Gantenbein's angular concrete wing.

pois.name: Museum Rietberg
pois.description: Dedicated to Asian, African, American, and Oceanian art, set inside historic Villa Wesendonck and the emerald subterranean Smaragd pavilion in Rieterpark.

pois.name: Pavillon Le Corbusier
pois.description: Le Corbusier's final architectural masterwork on the Lake Zurich promenade—a polychrome enameled steel-and-glass exhibition pavilion.

pois.name: Museum für Gestaltung Toni-Areal
pois.description: Swiss design, typography, poster graphics, and industrial architecture museum inside a converted former dairy factory in Zurich West.

pois.name: Kunsthalle Zürich
pois.description: Internationally acclaimed contemporary art institution inside the former Löwenbräu brewery complex.

pois.name: Helmhaus
pois.description: Municipal exhibition hall tucked beside the Wasserkirche at the Limmat bridge, presenting free contemporary Swiss art shows.

pois.name: Uhrenmuseum Beyer
pois.description: Intimate underground horology museum showcasing centuries of pocket watches, marine chronometers, and astronomical timepieces.

pois.name: Opernhaus Zürich
pois.description: Neo-baroque 1891 opera house fronting Lake Zurich's broad quartzite Sechseläutenplatz.

pois.name: ETH Polyterrasse
pois.description: Elevated university stone terrace linked to Central by the red 1889 Polybahn funicular, framing the city spires and Alps.

pois.name: Polybahn Funicular
pois.description: Historic crimson cable funicular climbing steeply from Central up to ETH Zurich's Polyterrasse since 1889.

pois.name: Old Botanical Garden
pois.description: 19th-century hilltop arboretum built atop the former Katz bastion moat, featuring a wooden medieval herb garden and octagonal palm house.

pois.name: Botanical Garden of the University of Zurich
pois.description: Lush hillside botanical park crowned by three futuristic geodesic greenhouse domes housing tropical, subtropical, and arid biomes.

pois.name: Chinese Garden Zurich
pois.description: Gift from Zurich's partner city Kunming—walled courtyard garden with a tranquil lotus pond, lacquered pavilions, and stone bridges.

pois.name: Zürichhorn Promenade
pois.description: Lakeside parkland dotted with Jean Tinguely's kinetic Heureka sculpture, cedar lawns, and views across to the Glarus Alps.

pois.name: Uetliberg Lookout Tower
pois.description: Zurich's home mountain summit at 871 meters, reached via the S10 mountain rail with panoramic trails across Lake Zurich and the Alps.

pois.name: Bürkliplatz Promenade
pois.description: Historic lakefront square and ferry pier framing the iconic Alpine panorama down Lake Zurich.

pois.name: Bahnhofstrasse
pois.description: Tree-lined pedestrian avenue running from Zürich HB to Bürkliplatz past historic banking halls, watchmakers, and Paradeplatz.

pois.name: Niederdorf Old Town
pois.description: Pedestrianized medieval lanes on the right bank lined with guild houses, bookshops, fountains, and independent boutiques.

pois.name: Münsterbrücke
pois.description: 1838 stone arch bridge linking Grossmünster and Fraumünster across the emerald Limmat.

pois.name: Rathaus Zürich
pois.description: Late-Renaissance 1698 town hall perched directly on stilts above the Limmat River.

pois.name: Wasserkirche
pois.description: Late-Gothic island church overlooking the Limmat with Giacometti stained glass and a vaulted stone crypt.

pois.name: Prime Tower District
pois.description: Faceted glass skyscraper anchoring the post-industrial Maag and Zurich West architecture quarter.

pois.name: Im Viadukt
pois.description: 36 vaulted sandstone arches beneath an 1894 railway viaduct converted into independent workshops, galleries, and a food hall.

pois.name: Schiffbau
pois.description: Converted 19th-century steamship factory now housing Schauspielhaus theater stages, Moods jazz club, and industrial brick courtyards.

pois.name: Cabaret Voltaire
pois.description: 1916 birthplace of the Dada avant-garde movement on Spiegelgasse, featuring archival salons and artist-curated rooms.

pois.name: FIFA Museum
pois.description: Interactive football heritage museum beside Bahnhof Enge showcasing historic World Cup trophies and cinema archives.

pois.name: Zoo Zürich
pois.description: Hillside conservation park famous for the misty Masoala Rainforest dome and Lewa Savanna.

pois.name: Lindt Home of Chocolate
pois.description: Christ & Gantenbein-designed circular atrium housing a nine-meter chocolate fountain and interactive Swiss cacao museum.

pois.name: Rote Fabrik
pois.description: Historic red-brick silk factory turned lakeside cultural complex with experimental studios and waterfront terraces.

pois.name: FocusTerra ETH
pois.description: Earth science and mineral treasury at ETH Zurich with Alpine tectonic models and luminous crystal vaults.

pois.name: NONAM North America Native Museum
pois.description: Intimate ethnographic museum highlighting Indigenous art, textiles, and architecture of North America.

pois.name: Mühlerama Mill Museum
pois.description: Working 1897 historic grain mill celebrating bread craft and industrial timber machinery.

pois.name: Museum Haus Konstruktiv
pois.description: Leading Swiss institution for concrete, constructive, and geometric conceptual art inside the historic EwZ power substation.

pois.name: Café Schober
pois.description: 1875 patisserie and hot-chocolate salon inside the historic Péclard townhouse on Napfgasse with painted ceilings and marble tables.

pois.name: Babu's Bakery & Coffeehouse
pois.description: Light-filled all-day bakery near Bahnhofstrasse serving homemade birchermüesli, brioche, and specialty filter roasts.

pois.name: MAME Seefeld
pois.description: Swiss Barista Champion specialty espresso and pour-over bar with minimalist timber counters.

pois.name: Café Henrici
pois.description: Bohemian Niederdorf specialty coffee corner serving single-origin flat whites and warm morning croissants.

pois.name: Confiserie Sprüngli Paradeplatz
pois.description: Iconic 1859 Swiss chocolatier and grand café famous for Luxemburgerli macarons and grand cru truffles.

pois.name: Café Odeon
pois.description: 1911 Art Nouveau grand café overlooking Bellevue where Einstein, Joyce, and Dadaists once gathered.

pois.name: ViCAFE Münsterhof
pois.description: Compact Swiss roastery espresso window set in an 18th-century stone archway beside Fraumünster.

pois.name: Bürkliplatz Market
pois.description: Lively lakeside open-air farmers and alpine cheese market along the chestnut avenues of Bürkliplatz.

pois.name: Markthalle Im Viadukt
pois.description: Covered local produce, alpine cheese, artisan bakery, and street-food hall inside Zurich's historic railway viaduct.

pois.name: Bäckerei St. Jakob
pois.description: Social-enterprise craft bakery known for crusty wood-fired sourdough and classic Swiss Gipfeli.

pois.name: Zeughauskeller
pois.description: Atmospheric 1487 vaulted medieval armory serving classic Zürcher Geschnetzeltes with crispy golden Rösti.

pois.name: Kronenhalle
pois.description: Storied 1924 brasserie dining room hung with original Miró, Chagall, and Matisse paintings on wood-paneled walls.

pois.name: Haus Hiltl
pois.description: Founded in 1898 and recognized as the world's oldest continuously open vegetarian restaurant, offering inventive Swiss and global dishes.

pois.name: Fischerstube Zürichhorn
pois.description: Timber lakeside pavilion built on pilings over Lake Zurich serving fresh local perch fillets and alpine wines.

pois.name: Zunfthaus zur Waag
pois.description: 17th-century weavers' guildhouse on cobblestone Münsterhof specializing in regional Swiss gastronomy.

pois.name: Frau Gerolds Garten
pois.description: Urban container garden beneath the train tracks with seasonal kitchen huts, herb beds, and open-air wooden benches.

pois.name: Sternen Grill
pois.description: Bellevue landmark counter famous since 1963 for crisp St. Galler Bratwurst with Bürli bread and spicy mustard.

pois.name: Restaurant Kindli
pois.description: Intimate 15th-century Altstadt dining room tucked in a cobbled alley beside Lindenhof serving refined Swiss classics.

pois.name: Raclette Factory
pois.description: Cozy Altstadt bistro devoted to melted Valais AOP mountain cheeses served over baby potatoes and pickled onions.

pois.name: Swiss Chuchi
pois.description: Long-running timber-clad Niederdorf fondue parlor inside Hotel Adler.

pois.name: Widder Bar
pois.description: Renowned cocktail sanctuary set within Tilla Theus's medieval-meets-modernist townhouse, celebrated for rare spirits and live jazz nights.

pois.name: Old Crow
pois.description: Tucked-away craft cocktail parlor boasting over 1,600 vintage spirits and meticulous apothecary glassware.

pois.name: Oepfelchammer
pois.description: 1801 historic wine tavern once frequented by Gottfried Keller, featuring carved oak booths and antique Swiss vintages.

pois.name: Jules Verne Panorama Bar
pois.description: Glass-ringed rooftop observatory lounge atop the Urania tower offering 360-degree views over the Limmat and lake.

pois.name: Rimini Bar
pois.description: Open-air wooden canal bathhouse transformed at dusk into a lantern-lit waterside aperitivo bar.

pois.name: Kronenhalle Bar
pois.description: Mahogany-and-brass classic bar by Diego Giacometti where tuxedoed bartenders pour dry martinis beneath original artworks.

pois.name: Bar Dante
pois.description: Intimate neighborhood aperitivo bar known for vermouths, natural Swiss wines, and warm terrazzo counters.
